要打开的条目已不存在，可能已被删除。目录仍可浏览；请从左侧目录重新选择。: This entry is no longer available. Choose another from the list.
这本书还没有关联世界书。: No story bible linked to this book.
回写作工作台右栏「关联世界书」完成关联后，这里会打开它的条目。: Use Link story bible in the writing sidebar to see its entries here.
描述世界观的基本设定、背景故事、核心概念等。这是 AI 生成内容时必须遵循的基础: World, background and core ideas the AI should follow.
定义叙事风格、语言风格、情感基调等。例如：采用第三人称叙事，语言简洁有力，注重心: Voice, language and tone. E.g. third person, concise prose, close attention to inner thoughts.
提供示例供 AI 参考，帮助理解预期的输出风格和格式。可以是优秀的叙事片段示例。: Add passages that illustrate the style and format you want.
定义 AI 不应该生成的内容类型、风格或元素。例如：避免过于现代的口语、不出现某: Content, styles or elements to avoid. E.g. modern slang or specific topics.
导入前会先显示摘要预览，确认后再创建新世界书。: Preview the file before confirming. Import creates a new story bible.
当前没有分组，可先创建。: No groups yet. Create one below.
模型只提出候选，确认后才会写入条目。: AI suggests changes. Entries change only when you apply them.
可选：补充审查重点，例如“重点检查角色关系和历史年代是否冲突”。: Optional: focus on character relationships, dates or other details.
例如：保留已有时间线，补充这个势力与北境盐路的利益关系，不要创造新年代。: E.g. keep the timeline and clarify this faction’s interests in the salt route.
例如：增加一个控制北境盐路的商会，和霜港存在利益冲突，但不要改变已有历史。: E.g. add a salt-trading guild in conflict with the port, without changing established history.
世界书已在生成后发生变化，这批建议已过期。请重新运行审查，避免覆盖新的设定。: The story bible has changed. These suggestions are outdated. Run a new review to protect your latest changes.
只锚定当前说话角色；生成时最多使用前 3 条，空白与重复样例会在保存时清理。: Applies only to this speaker. AI uses up to the first three examples. Empty and duplicate examples are removed on save.
句长、措辞、回避或强调习惯: Sentence length, phrasing, avoidance or emphasis
拉丁文本要求词边界匹配（中文默认短语匹配）: Match word boundaries in Latin text. Chinese uses phrase matching.
修改后点击「保存条目」生效: Click Save entry to apply changes.
请选择一个条目进行编辑，或点击“新增条目”。: Select an entry to edit, or choose New entry.
尚无可编辑世界书，点击上方“新建世界书”开始。: Choose New story bible to get started.
JSON 结构无效：需要对象根节点: Invalid JSON: the root must be an object.
世界书处理失败。: Could not process the story bible.
请先输入自然语言要求或选择条目。: Enter instructions or select entries first.
AI 返回无法解析为世界书处理结果。: Could not read the AI’s proposed changes.
AI 返回的世界书处理结果未通过本地校验。: The AI’s proposed changes did not pass validation.
上游模型连续返回空内容，已自动重试 3 次；请检查当前模型是否只输出思考过程，或: The model returned no content after three retries. Check whether it only returned reasoning, or try another text model.
已生成候选，请逐项审阅。: Suggestions ready. Review each before applying.
世界书已经发生变化，这批建议已过期，请重新审查。: The story bible has changed. Run a new review before applying suggestions.
这条建议涉及本批次中已经修改过的条目，请重新审查后再采纳，避免旧建议覆盖刚保存的: This suggestion affects entries already changed in this batch. Run a new review to avoid overwriting those changes.
建议内容为空，请先编辑或重新生成。: The suggestion is empty. Edit it or generate again.
建议对应的条目已经不存在。: The suggested entry no longer exists.
目标分组「{target}」已存在，重命名将合并条目，是否继续？: Group “{target}” exists. Renaming will combine the groups’ entries. Continue?
确认将「{source}」的条目迁移到「{target}」，并删除源分组？: Move entries from “{source}” to “{target}” and delete the source group?
确认将「{source}」的条目迁移到「{target}」并保留源分组？: Move entries from “{source}” to “{target}” and keep the source group?
已迁移 {count} 条条目到「{target}」，并删除了源分组。: Moved {count} entries to “{target}” and deleted the source group.
确认删除分组「{source}」？其中 {count} 条条目的分组将被清空。: Delete group “{source}”? Its {count} entries will become ungrouped, not deleted.
悬停看邻域 · 点节点打开词条 · Alt+点聚焦邻域 · Shift+拖节点建: Hover to preview neighbors · click a node to open the entry · Alt+click to focus its neighborhood · Shift+drag to create an edge · drag to pan · scroll to zoom · double-click empty space to reset
已聚焦「{title}」邻域 — Alt+再点或双击空白取消: Focused on "{title}" and its neighbors — Alt+click again or double-click empty space to clear
保存档案并投影正文: Save profile and project to content
写下一章必知的事实与悬置钩子，不写过程。: Facts and open hooks the next chapter must know — not the process.
仅显示「{cat}」— 再点图例取消: Showing only "{cat}" — click the legend again to clear
当前过滤条件下没有词条 — 放宽分类/状态/档位即可原位恢复: No entries match these filters — loosen category / status / tier to bring them back in place
有尚未保存的设定修改，切换作品会丢弃这些修改。仍要切换吗？: Unsaved setting changes will be lost if you switch books. Switch anyway?
本章确立的新设定事实，例如：盐引制度由潮盐行会垄断: New world facts established this chapter, e.g. the salt monopoly of the Tide Salt Guild
检索：标题 / 触发词 / 标签 / 摘要（本地即时轨）: Search: title / keys / tags / summary (local instant track)
粘贴一轮生成或本章片段，点「生成结算草案」。: Paste a generated turn or chapter fragment, then click "Draft settlement".
该角色不会说的词: Words this character would never say
本表编辑字段的落点：: Where this table writes field edits:
之后字段编辑会覆盖条目正文: Later field edits will overwrite entry text
之后字段编辑只存字段，不动条目正文: Later field edits save fields only, leaving entry text untouched
正文与投影不一致: Entry text differs from the projection
正文与字段投影对不上（可能有手写内容，也可能还没写正文）。之后在本表改字段，怎么: The entry text and the field projection no longer match (there may be handwritten text, or no text yet). How should later field edits in this table be written?
这一格与正文不一致；改用「覆盖条目正文」把它写进正文: This cell no longer matches the entry text. Switch to "overwrite entry text" to write it into the text.
这本书的世界书里还没有人物条目。: This book's story bible has no characters yet.
已新建人物，先在表单里选模板: Character added. Choose a template in the form first.
这一行还没选模板：点「展开」在表单里选好模板，再回来改字段: This row has no template yet. Click "expand", choose a template in the form, then edit fields here.
已写入这本书的世界书文件: Written to this book's story bible file
这条人物刚被改过，这一格的改动已丢弃，请重新编辑: This character changed while you were deciding, so this cell's edit was discarded. Please edit it again.
选择模板决定字段集；保存时会把字段投影成条目正文。若正文已被手动修改，会先请你选: The template decides the fields. On save, the fields are projected into the entry text. If the text has been edited by hand, you will first be asked whether to keep it or overwrite it.
模板之外的字段（含正文里识别出的【自定义标签】）在这里编辑；保存时会一并投影进正: Fields outside the template (including 【custom labels】 read back from the text) are edited here, and are projected into the text on save.
声口设定（说话方式与示例台词）: Voice settings (way of speaking and sample lines)
条目正文已被手动修改，与模板投影不一致。请选择保留哪一份：: The entry text has been edited by hand and no longer matches the template projection. Choose which one to keep:
再点一次「确认删除」就摘掉这一行（条目正文与字段一起删）；结算台账类条目不在表里: Press Confirm delete once more to remove this row; the entry text and its fields go with it. Settlement ledger entries are not listed here, so they cannot be deleted by mistake.
已删除「{name}」，世界书文件同步更新: Deleted “{name}”. The story bible files are updated too.
当前过滤下没有行：清除过滤，或回浏览视图放宽轴就回来了。: No rows match the current filter. Clear it here, or widen the axes in the Browse view.
这本书的世界书里还没有词条。: This book's story bible has no entries yet.
结算链的机器可读台账：状态只认 未回收 / 已回收 / 作废: The settlement chain's machine-readable ledger. Status is one of Open / Paid off / Dropped.
这本书的世界书里还没有伏笔台账。建立后，章回结算写台账时会复用同一条目。: This book's story bible has no foreshadowing ledger yet. Once created, chapter settlement reuses the same entry.
伏笔台账已建立（与章回结算共用同一条目）: Foreshadowing ledger created. Chapter settlement writes to the same entry.
台账还是空的：点上方「＋ 登记一条伏笔」就能落第一行。: The ledger is empty. Click ＋ Plant a foreshadow above to add the first row.
fid 是台账主键，改编号请另起一行再删旧行: fid is the ledger key. To change an id, add a new row and delete the old one.
fid 是台账主键，先给个编号（例如 F01）: fid is the ledger key. Give it an id first (e.g. F01).
台账里已经有 {fid} 这一行了：要改它就点那一格，要另起一条请换个编号: Row {fid} already exists in the ledger. Click one of its cells to edit it, or use a different id for a new row.
再点一次「确认删除」就把 {fid} 这一行从台账摘掉；伏笔本体若已写进条目正文: Press Confirm delete once more to remove row {fid} from the ledger. If the foreshadow is also written into an entry's text, you will need to handle it there.
没有匹配的台账行，未写入: No matching ledger row, nothing written.
